articles.description: — Julius Randle scored 28 points and Noah Clowney had 17 as the Brooklyn Nets beat the Milwaukee Bucks 104-97 to snap a five-game losing streak on Wednesday night in NBA Cup play.

articles.headline: Wells and Jerome lead the Grizzlies to a 115-97 win over the Clippers, who fall to 0-9 on the road
articles.description: — Jaylen Wells scored 19 points, Ty Jerome added 17 points and seven assists, and the Memphis Grizzles beat the Clippers 115-70 on Wednesday night in an NBA Cup game, dropping Los Angeles to 0-9 on the road.

articles.headline: Timberwolves beat the Thunder 113-106 to improve to 3-0 in NBA Cup play
articles.description: — Jaden McDaniels had 32 points and 10 rebounds, LaMelo Ball added 19 points before leaving with an ankle injury and the Minnesota Timberwolves improved to 3-0 in NBA Cup play with a 113-106 win over the Oklahoma City Thunder on Wednesday night.
